items.html: Now, all seven of the last of the Nekudot are in the form of Yods, except for the two first Nekudot, which are Kamatz and Patach, which are two Vavs and a Yod. And the matter is that when we count all the Yods that are in these seven Nekudot, they are thirteen Yods, in Gematria 130, like the number of “eye” [Ayin], to indicate that from the eye the Nekudot came out. And there remain Kamatz and Patach, which are a Yod and two Vavs, which are in Gematria 22; and this is the secret of the twenty-two letters, from which the vessels of the Nekudim were made.
